kebab_example: aliyun cloudesl assign-user --stores s-dxsxxxxxx,s-dxsyyyyyyy --user-id 1344000 --user-type USER_TYPE_COMPANY_OWNER --extra-params example-string --api-version 2020-02-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssignUser

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud RAM user
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the user. Valid values:

`USER_TYPE_COMPANY_ROOT`: Super merchant administrator. This role can create, read, update, and delete accounts related to merchants and stores.

`USER_TYPE_COMPANY_ADMIN`: Merchant administrator. This role can create, read, update, and delete accounts related to stores under the merchant.

`USER_TYPE_STORE_ADMIN`: Store administrator. A store administrator can be associated with multiple stores, but each store can only be associated with one store administrator.

`USER_TYPE_STORE_OPERATOR`: Store operator. This role can only be associated with one store.

`USER_TYPE_GUEST`: Guest with no permissions
parameters.help_zh:
用户类型，可选值：

`USER_TYPE_COMPANY_ROOT`：高级商家管理员，商家和门店相关账号的增删改查；

`USER_TYPE_COMPANY_ADMIN`：商家管理员，商家下的门店相关账号的增删改查；

`USER_TYPE_STORE_ADMIN`：门店管理员，一个门店管理员可关联多个门店，但一个门店仅能关联一个门店管理员；

`USER_TYPE_STORE_OPERATOR`：门店操作员，仅能关联一个门店；

`USER_TYPE_GUEST`：没有任何权限的访客
parameters.name: user_type
